info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Network Participant Facility Management API
info.description: The Card Network Participant Facility Management API allows businesses to update the details of network participant facilities associated with their card services. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate facility information, ensuring compliance, and enhancing service quality. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and card service providers that need to manage participant details as they adapt to changing business needs. By utilizing this API, organizations can effectively oversee their network participant facilities and support seamless card operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific card network participant facility identified by the given ID. You can modify various attributes related to the facility to ensure that the information is up-to-date and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific card network participant facility, identified by CARD-400045. It contains the necessary information in JSON format to perform the update operation.

200.description: The patch request was successfully executed, and the resource has been updated.
